newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Russia's Dubinin hopes for two percent 1997 growth.
newsitem.headline: Russia's Dubinin hopes for two percent 1997 growth.

text.p: Russian central bank president Sergei Dubinin said on Monday he hoped economic growth would pick up this year, leaving Russia able to reach a two percent growth rate.

"I hope we will have our two percent growth this year," Dubinin told journalists at the annual meeting of the Bank for International Settlements, adding that in some industries there was already "good growth".
"The macroeconomic situation in stable in Russia," Dubinin said, adding: "The main problem connected with our budget deficit is under strict supervision of the government."
